title: Navigating the Thin Line: Examining User Behavior in Search to Detect Engagement and Backfire Effects
findings: The study did not report findings specific to the topic of atheism, but aggregated results across all three debated topics. The key findings were that exposing opinionated users to biased search results (on topics like atheism) increased their consumption of content that opposed their own views. However, this exposure was also associated with fewer overall interactions with the search page. A notable 19% of users abandoned the search task without clicking any results, suggesting a potential backfire effect when presented with biased, attitude-opposing information.
